nodes.title: Invoice export retries at most 3 times with exponential backoff
nodes.summary: Retries are capped at 3 with 1s, 2s, 4s waits because the export API allows 5 calls per minute.

nodes.title: Export client must not swallow 429 responses
nodes.summary: The client dropped rate-limit responses silently, so failures looked like empty exports.

nodes.title: A retry test fakes the clock
nodes.summary: Without a fake clock the retry test sleeps for seven seconds.
